Hi Aditya and Laura,

Quick note from Acme ahead of the QBR next week — we pulled the April dashboard and see a noticeable uptick in 95th-percentile latency (from ~420ms in March to ~760ms this week) and a ~22% jump in monthly inference spend relative to what we expected for our usage pattern. Uptime is still within SLAs but we had two short degradations last Friday (15-20m) that briefly impacted batch jobs.

Can you confirm whether this is due to model changes, an infra config (batching/queueing), or routing to a different capacity tier? We need a short write-up for our internal ops review and would like a quick sync to align the QBR deck — we plan to highlight any root cause and mitigations.

Example asks:
- 95p latency breakdown by model and region for Apr 1–14
- Top 3 drivers of cost increase (tokens, model size, fallback routing)
- Timeline estimate for mitigation (config + runbook changes)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this week. I can do Fri 10–11am PDT or Mon 8–9am PDT.

Best,
Erin
Ops Lead, Acme Retail

Team / Erin,

I ran the 95p latency slices and attached the working dashboard (2027-04-kpi-dashboard.xlsx). Early observations:
- 95p latency increased primarily on the long-tail conversational endpoints in us-west (model: redwood-v2-l, median stable but 95p jumped ~330ms).
- We had two kernel rollouts the week of Apr 5 that impacted batching efficiency for sequence lengths >1024 — those rollouts were inward-facing performance experiments and should have been flagged to customers, apologies.
- Fallback routing increased by 12% on Apr 12 when a new autoscaler policy was exercised due to a burst from a partner integration. That drove additional higher-cost model invocations for a short window.

I've attached a short POV (qbr-pov-notes.pdf) with recommended mitigations: rollback the kernel experiment for the L model on us-west (low risk), tighten the autoscaler policy threshold for partner bursts, and enable a per-route KV caching TTL for the conversational endpoints. Estimated impact: 40–60% reduction in observed 95p within 48–72 hours if implemented.

Marissa, can you confirm cost delta numbers and token breakdowns? Vivek, can you validate the rollback plan and estimate runway to execute?

Laura
Director, Observability & Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
